module TopModule (
    input clk,

);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 10'b0; // Reset the counter to 0

            if (q == 10'd999) begin
                q <= 10'b0; // Reset to 0 after reaching 999

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  x,
    output reg z
);

    // State encoding
    localparam A = 2'b01; // State A
    localparam B = 2'b10; // State B

    reg [1:0] state; // One-hot state representation

    // Asynchronous reset
    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= A; // Reset to state A
            z <= 0;     // Output z reset to 0
        end else begin
            case (state)
                A: begin
                    if (x) begin
                        state <= B; // Transition to state B
                        z <= 1;     // Output z = 1
                    end else begin
                        state <= A; // Stay in state A
                        z <= 0;     // Output z = 0
                    end
                end
                B: begin
                    if (x) begin
                        state <= B; // Stay in state B
                        z <= 0;     // Output z = 0
                    end else begin
                        state <= B; // Stay in state B
                        z <= 1;     // Output z = 1
                    end
                end
                default: begin
                    state <= A; // Default to state A
                    z <= 0;     // Default output
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  x,
    output reg z
);

    typedef enum reg [1:0] {
        IDLE,
        INVERT,
        OUTPUT
    } state_t;

    state_t current_state, next_state;
    reg [1:0] count; // To count the number of bits received

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            current_state <= IDLE;
            count <= 0;
            z <= 0;
        end else begin
            current_state <= next_state;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        next_state = current_state;
        z = 0; // Default output

        case (current_state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (!areset) begin
                    next_state = INVERT; // Start processing when reset is released
                end
            end

            INVERT: begin
                z = ~x; // Invert the input bit
                count = count + 1; // Increment the bit count
                if (count == 2'b11) begin // Assuming we want to stop after 3 bits
                    next_state = OUTPUT; // Move to OUTPUT state
                end
            end

            OUTPUT: begin
                z = z + 1; // Add 1 to complete 2's complement
                next_state = IDLE; // Go back to IDLE
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input areset,
    input x,
    output reg z
);

    reg [31:0] bit_count; // Assuming a maximum of 32 bits for the input
    reg [31:0] temp;      // Temporary storage for the input bits
    reg [31:0] result;    // Result of the 2's complement
    reg [4:0] state;      // State variable

    localparam IDLE = 5'b00001, 
               CAPTURE = 5'b00010, 
               COMPLEMENT = 5'b00100, 
               OUTPUT = 5'b01000;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            bit_count <= 0;
            temp <= 0;
            z <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (!areset) begin
                        state <= CAPTURE;
                        bit_count <= 0;
                    end
                end
                
                CAPTURE: begin
                    temp[bit_count] <= x; // Capture the input bit
                    bit_count <= bit_count + 1;
                    if (bit_count == 31) begin // Assuming a maximum of 32 bits
                        state <= COMPLEMENT;
                    end
                end
                
                COMPLEMENT: begin
                    result <= ~temp + 1; // Calculate 2's complement
                    state <= OUTPUT;
                end
                
                OUTPUT: begin
                    z <= result[0]; // Output the least significant bit
                    result <= result >> 1; // Shift right for next output
                    if (result == 0) begin
                        state <= IDLE; // Go back to IDLE when done
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

            shift_ena <= 1'b1; // Enable shift for the first cycle

        end else if (count < 2'b11) begin
            count <= count + 1; // Increment counter
            shift_ena <= 1'b1;   // Keep shift enabled
        end else begin
            shift_ena <= 1'b0;   // Disable shift after 4 cycles
        end
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input data,
    output reg start_shifting
);

    // State encoding
    typedef enum reg [2:0] {
        S0 = 3'b000,
        S1 = 3'b001,
        S2 = 3'b010,
        S3 = 3'b011,
        S4 = 3'b100
    } state_t;

    state_t current_state, next_state;

    // State transition logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            current_state <= S0;
            start_shifting <= 0;
        end else begin
            current_state <= next_state;
        end
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (current_state)
            S0: begin
                if (data) next_state = S1; // 1
                else next_state = S0;
            end
            S1: begin
                if (data) next_state = S2; // 11
                else next_state = S0;
            end
            S2: begin
                if (data) next_state = S3; // 110
                else next_state = S0;
            end
            S3: begin
                if (data) begin
                    next_state = S4; // 1101
                    start_shifting = 1; // Found sequence
                end else begin
                    next_state = S0;
                end
            end
            S4: begin
                next_state = S4; // Stay in S4 after finding sequence
                start_shifting = 1; // Keep start_shifting high
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = S0;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  [1:0] ena,
    input  [99:0] data,
    output reg [99:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data; // Load data into the register
        end else begin
            case (ena)
                2'b01: begin
                    // Rotate right by one bit
                    q <= {q[0], q[99:1]};
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    // Rotate left by one bit
                    q <= {q[98:0], q[99]};
                end
                2'b00, 2'b11: begin
                    // Do not rotate
                    q <= q;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

    always @(*) begin
        case (current_state)
            B: begin
                if (in == 0) begin
                    next_state = A;
                    out = 1; // Output for state B
                end else begin
                    next_state = B;
                    out = 1; // Output for state B
                end

                if (in == 0) begin
                    next_state = B;
                    out = 0; // Output for state A

                    next_state = A;
                    out = 0; // Output for state A
                end
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = B; // Default to state B
                out = 1; // Default output for state B
            end
        endcase
    end

    // State update on clock edge
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            current_state <= B; // Reset to state B
            out <= 1; // Output for state B
        end else begin
            current_state <= next_state; // Update current state
        end
    end

    input  wire       clk,
    input  wire       reset,
    input  wire       slowena,
    output reg  [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'd0;
        end else if (slowena) begin
            if (q == 4'd9) begin
                q <= 4'd0;
            end else begin
                q <= q + 4'd1;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
